values.note: 41 campsites (one wheelchair accessible) plus a group site and three yurts. FWP: 'Maximum RV/trailer length is 40 feet.' On ReserveAmerica 40 plain campsites run 17-45 ft (most 25-35 ft, three walk-in) and one 'Campsite Electric' (B004, 40 ft); the five pull-throughs are 18 ft.

values.note: Water, showers and flush toilets mid-May to mid-September. Bear-resistant food lockers; firewood for sale.

note: MT FWP state park on Big Arm Bay, SW shore of Flathead Lake, 15 mi north of Polson on US-93, inside the Flathead Reservation (tribal permit and licence needed for recreation and fishing outside the park). Camping under mature ponderosa pine and juniper by a long pebble beach; boat launch, archery range, jumping-off point for Wild Horse Island. --Claude
summary: FWP page confirms 41 campsites + group site + 3 yurts, 40-ft max RV/trailer, reservable on ReserveAmerica (derived values now verified); added showers/flush and vault toilets/water (seasonal, mid-May to mid-Sept) and pull-throughs. Campground season (April-October) already manual; fees left as recorded (the page gives only the statewide $4-$34 range). Booking window/cutoff/7-night limit not stated on the park page, left inherited. Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: ReserveAmerica tags most Big Arm campsites (and the group site) 'Near Water', and FWP describes camping by a long pebble beach on Big Arm Bay; the entry is lakeview.
Hookups not recorded: ReserveAmerica sells one 'Campsite Electric' (B004, 40 ft) among 40 non-electric sites, amperage not shown; FWP's statewide list of parks with electric campsites omits Big Arm.
